verdict.rationale: angular-docs-3 explicitly claims Angular ships first-party modules for forms (alongside routing) that integrate with the rest of the framework, consistent with Angular's known Reactive/Template-driven Forms modules. However, the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation of validators, form APIs, or integration specifics, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of forms specifically is present. missing for 10: dedicated forms API/validator documentation, community or hands-on confirmation of forms integration quality.
